transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I came in because I’m not eating right anymore. Some days it’s just coffee, maybe a piece of bread, and that’s it. My pants are getting loose on me, like I’m losing weight without really trying.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or have you lost interest in activities you usually enjoy?
Yeah… most days I wake up feeling really low. It’s like this heavy, empty feeling in my chest, like there’s nothing good waiting for me. I just want to keep my head down and get through it, I guess.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, or found less pleasure in doing things that used to make you happy?

Yeah. I used to like walking by the lake, and I had these little model kits I’d work on. Now I just… don’t care. They’re sitting there, and when I look at them it feels like they belong to somebody else.
Have you been feeling more tired or lacking energy lately, even if you’re not doing much? Like even small tasks feel really hard?
Yeah. I’m tired all the time. Even taking out the trash feels like too much. Coming here today felt like… a big thing. My arms and legs just feel heavy, like they’re full of wet sand.
Have you been feeling like you’re not good enough, or been blaming yourself for things more than usual?

Yeah… I do. I keep thinking I’m no good, like I messed everything up. Losing that job just stays in my head, and now my relatives have to help me, so I feel like a burden. I keep going over every mistake I made, like I ruined everything.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt down and lost interest in things, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way?
I’m not really sure. I’ve felt down before, but I don’t know if it was like this. This feels pretty bad, but I can’t say for sure if it’s happened the same way before.
Can you think back and tell me if you’ve had times in the past where you felt this same way—down, tired, and losing interest in things—for a period of at least two weeks?
I’m not sure. I’ve had low times before, yeah, but I can’t really remember if it was this same thing for two weeks or more. It all kind of blurs together when I try to think back.
Can you think back to any time in the past when you felt this same way — down, tired, and losing interest in things — for a period of two weeks or more?
I honestly don’t know. I’ve had times where I felt low before, but I can’t really tell if it was the same as this or if it lasted two weeks. I don’t remember it clearly enough.
Can you think back to any time in the past when you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for a period of two weeks or more?
I really can’t say for sure. I know I’ve had rough patches before where I was down and didn’t feel like doing much, but I don’t remember the timing well enough to say it was two weeks or more.
Can you think back to any time in the past when you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy for a period of two weeks or more?
I’m not sure about before, but this time it’s been going on a long while. I’d say about five months now, feeling like this.
Can you think of any other distinct times in your life, separate from this current episode, when you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day for at least two weeks?

I can’t really think of another clear time like that, no. I’ve had bad stretches before, but I don’t know if they were nearly every day or lasted at least two weeks. This current one is the only one I can really point to.
Can you think back to any time before this current period when you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Not really. I mean, I’ve had times where I felt low before, but I can’t say it was every day for two weeks like that. This current time is the only one I can really say has been like that.

Can you think of any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?

I don’t think so. I can’t really remember a separate time like that before this one, where it lasted two weeks and then I got better for a couple months. This current episode is the only one I can clearly say has been like that.

Can you think of any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?

I don’t think I can name a time like that before this. I’ve had rough periods, but I’m not sure they were that long or that clear, and I don’t remember having a couple months after where I was definitely back to normal.

Can you think of any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?

I really don’t remember a clear time like that before now. I’ve felt bad at different times, but I can’t say it was two weeks straight and then I was better for a couple months. I just don’t have a solid example.

Can you recall any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?

I’m not really able to recall one, no. I know I’ve had bad stretches before, but I can’t pin down a time before this where it was at least two weeks like that and then I was clearly better for two months.

Can you recall any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?
No, I can’t really recall a clear time like that. I’ve had times where I felt low, but I don’t know if it was that long or if I had two months after where I was really back to normal.

Can you recall any time before this current episode when you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt down, lost interest in things, and had low energy nearly every day, and that was followed by at least two months where you felt significantly better or back to normal?

I don’t have another example to give you. I’ve been trying to think, but I can’t remember a clear stretch before this that fits that pattern, with the two weeks bad and then a couple months clearly better.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient meets criteria for a moderate depressive episode (F32.3) based on the presence of multiple core depressive symptoms nearly every day for over five months, including depressed mood, anhedonia, low energy, feelings of worthlessness, and significant functional impairment. There is no clear history of prior episodes with remission, ruling out recurrent depressive disorder. The severity is moderate given the number and persistence of symptoms, but without features such as psychomotor retardation or suicidal ideation that would suggest a severe episode.
